data.name: Parminder
data.gender_notes: Parminder is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Parminder is a name derived from the Sanskrit language. It is a compound name where 'Parm' means supreme or universal and 'inder' means lord or master. Hence, Parminder translates to 'Lord of the World'. In Hindu mythology, this name is associated with Lord Shiva, who is regarded as the supreme god and ruler of the universe.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the divine presence and supreme power within.
data.etymology: Parminder belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Lord of the World.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Parminder total 8, giving a life-path number of 8. Number 8 is linked with Saturn and with the qualities of ambition, resilience and material success.
